### 🔵 Needs a closer look Preserve flexible severity matching while allowing whitespace around the badge attribute equals sign. **0 open findings**
Previously missed (2) In code that hasn't changed since last review
Severity badge pattern misses text after "severity" `plugins/​monitor-pr/​scripts/​resolve-copilot-threads:1327` write-bash-scripts: Script behavior. This tightened pattern only matches `severity` when it is the last text in the `alt` value. The previous pattern recognized any value containing `severity`, so a badge such as `alt="High severity icon"` is now omitted from the census and can let an otherwise unread badge finding appear clean. Keep the flexible suffix while adding whitespace tolerance around `=` (for example, use `alt[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*"[^"]*severity[^"]*"`).
